newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar barely changed amid tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar barely changed amid tight liquidity.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar was barely changed in early Tuesday trade and dealers expected the rate to stabilise amid tightening liquidity in the money market and the central bank's determination to smooth any depreciation.
The local unit rose to T$27.885 at the open, but minor U.S. dollar buying soon emerged. After 45 minutes, or 0145 GMT, the Taiwan dollar was at T$27.893 against Monday's T$27.892 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$19 million.
Inspired by a red hot stock market, dealers said some investors have been selling U.S. dollars to raise local currency for stock investments.
They noted that the central bank had shown a strong determination to smooth the Taiwan dollar's persistent depreciation since April.
"The Taiwan dollar's room for movement is extremely limited for the time being," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.85-91 trading range was seen for Tuesday.
